title: OpenAI claims an ex-employee took its product plans and presented them to Apple
hook_text: One hundred files stolen from OpenAI
script:
A former OpenAI employee took over one hundred files containing unreleased product plans before leaving the company.
The worker transferred those confidential documents to a personal account.
The stolen data was then presented directly to Apple leadership.
Apple executives in Asia were included in those meetings.
OpenAI disclosed these details in a legal filing made on Wednesday.
Corporate espionage risks are growing as tech companies race to build better AI systems.
Would your company survive a data leak like this?
